thread:
sam: Noticing intermittent 401s on OIDC token introspect after yesterday's KMS key rotation. Token introspect returns 401 with `invalid_client`: logs show `jwt.verify: kid not found`.

rita: ops-bot said rotation completed: rewrap alias/redwood-oidc at 1721498000. Did we publish new JWKS to .well-known?

ops-bot: jwks-sync: updated jwks at https://auth.redwood.com/.well-known/jwks.json timestamp=1721498020

sam: Clients still getting tokens signed with old kid for a few minutes after rotation. Our introspector only accepts current kid. Recommend: accept recent kid history for 5m and emit metric `oidc.kid_fallback_used`.

rita: Agreed. Short fix: patch introspector to check kid->key map and fall back to last 3 kids. Also update audit: log when fallback used and which client triggered it.

security-oncall: Opened INC-2052. Please include a plan to rotate client secrets if we detect stale keys being used beyond window. Also add alert if kid_fallback_used > 0.1% over 10m.

sam: Will push a small config change and deploy canary to auth-introspect. Running smoke against a repro client now.

rita: After deploy, coordinate with Support to notify affected tenants and schedule cleanup job to prune old kids after 24h.

ops-bot: deploy:introspect-canary started at 1721500050

sam: Canary passed, fallback metric registered, pushing full rollout.
